note: BH-9906: the budget of the whole verify block of a fix round (typecheck, unit, closure lint, ci-local, selection gate, repro), separate from BR_FIX_AGENT_TIMEOUT. Each typecheck and unit command runs under the seconds left; a later step with none left writes VERIFY_TIMEOUT: <step>. A round whose verification ran out ends FIX_RESULT verify-timeout and keeps the agent commit for a verify-only retry. The box bounds a round at BR_FIX_AGENT_TIMEOUT + BR_FIX_VERIFY_TIMEOUT + BR_FIX_HOP_MARGIN.
